meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: UbuWeb home page: header spacing and the founding blurb (static site, few annoyances)
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome (iPhone UA and desktop UA) on ubu.com (home page) only. The site is hand-written static HTML with no scripts that inject content, no cookie banner, no ads and no app banner, so the three generic options match nothing and there is little to hide. The section pages (film, sound, papers and so on) were not loaded, so none of their markup is covered.

- **Blank header space**: the div.header-spacer (1) and the img[src$=dot_clear.gif] spacer pictures (2) on the home page (LIVE). The decorative banner is a body background image, which rules cannot touch, so it stays.
- **Founding blurb** (Show/Dim/Hide): div.archive, 1 (LIVE). Dim is a css opacity rule, Hide a hide rule.

The section list (div.ubu-links), the search box and the page title are never matched. Same page for both user agents.
